# Slate

> Production management for creative teams. Track projects, pay crew, send invoices, and see your real profit per project. Free tools and templates for video production companies and freelance crew.

Slate (slate.sdubmedia.com) is the paid product. Slate Freelance (freelance.sdubmedia.com) is a separate app for live-event freelance crew. getslate.net is the marketing site that hosts free production-industry tools and templates.

## Apps

- [Slate](https://getslate.net): Production management for video production companies. Free up to 10 projects, $9.99/mo Basic, $19.99/mo Pro.
- [Slate Freelance](https://freelance.sdubmedia.com): Gig tracking for live-event freelance crew. Same pricing, different app.

## Free tools

### Billing

- [Invoice Generator](https://getslate.net/invoice-generator): Fill a form, download a clean PDF invoice.
- [Profit Calculator](https://getslate.net/calculator): 3 questions — what you're actually making per month.
- [Expense Categorizer](https://getslate.net/expenses): Upload a bank CSV, auto-sorted into Schedule C.
- [Rate Card](https://getslate.net/templates/rate-card): Clean downloadable rate sheet for client inquiries.
- [Late Payment Letter](https://getslate.net/templates/late-payment): Friendly / firm / final — pick a tone.
- [Late Fee Addendum](https://getslate.net/templates/late-fee-addendum): Amend a contract to add late-payment penalties.
- [Payment Plan Agreement](https://getslate.net/templates/payment-plan): Installment schedule when client can't pay up front.
- [Deposit Receipt](https://getslate.net/templates/deposit-receipt): Formal acknowledgment when a deposit arrives.
- [Change Order](https://getslate.net/templates/change-order): Document scope creep, get it signed, protect margin.
- [W-9 Request Letter](https://getslate.net/templates/w9-request): Professional ask for a contractor's W-9.

### Agreements

- [Video Production Contract](https://getslate.net/templates/contract): Fillable starting point for commercial video work.
- [Proposal / Statement of Work](https://getslate.net/templates/proposal): Pre-contract pitch with scope + line items.
- [Independent Contractor Agreement](https://getslate.net/templates/ic-agreement): Hiring a 1099 editor or crew. IP assignment included.
- [Equipment Rental Agreement](https://getslate.net/templates/equipment-rental): Rent gear to (or from) another crew.

### Releases & Licensing

- [Model Release](https://getslate.net/templates/model-release): Standard adult model release form.
- [Minor Model Release](https://getslate.net/templates/minor-release): Parental consent for subjects under 18.
- [Location Release](https://getslate.net/templates/location-release): Permission to shoot on private property.
- [Usage License](https://getslate.net/templates/usage-license): Granular rights grant for specific deliverables.
- [Music License Request](https://getslate.net/templates/music-license): Ask for sync / background music rights.

### Production

- [Call Sheet](https://getslate.net/templates/call-sheet): Shoot-day bible: crew, call times, weather, hospital.
- [Shot List](https://getslate.net/templates/shot-list): Scene-by-scene breakdown with lens notes.
- [Creative Brief](https://getslate.net/templates/creative-brief): Kickoff document filled out WITH the client.
- [Client Intake Questionnaire](https://getslate.net/templates/client-intake): Pre-kickoff form that becomes your brief.
- [Project Wrap Report](https://getslate.net/templates/wrap-report): End-of-project recap with final invoice.
- [Drone Flight Log (Part 107)](https://getslate.net/drone-log): Track every flight for FAA compliance + tax records.

### Marketing

- [Testimonial Request Letter](https://getslate.net/templates/testimonial-request): Short, human ask after a successful project.
